inputs.52.text: Soft painterly picture-book illustration in thick, velvety gouache: visible round brush strokes, colours laid in soft overlapping layers, edges melting gently into one another, a faint warm paper grain under the paint. A narrow old hillside harbour town in steady rain, seen wide from a high rooftop: slate-blue tiled rooftops, utility poles and small houses stepping down toward a grey-teal harbour, wet lanes holding long amber reflections of lit windows, an open misty grey-violet sky over the water. Palette of deep slate blue, misty teal and grey-violet, warm honey amber in every window. Diffuse rainy light, soft atmospheric haze in the distance.
